description: Checks limits, account status and fraud rules

description: Takes money out of the sender account and adds it to the receiver account

name: Send transfer
description: Accept one new transfer for processing.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent by transferId. A repeated transferId must not send the money again.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: transferId
requestFields.description: Unique transfer identifier, created by the app.

requestFields.name: fromAccount
requestFields.description: Account to take the money from (IBAN).

requestFields.name: toAccount
requestFields.description: Account to send the money to (IBAN).

responseFields.name: eventId
responseFields.description: Identifier of the recorded acceptance event.

name: Change scheduled transfer
description: Replace a transfer that is scheduled for a later date.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent for the same transferId and version.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: version
requestFields.description: Current version, used to detect parallel changes.

requestFields.name: executionDate
requestFields.description: New date to send the money.

name: Get transfer status
description: Return the current processing state of one transfer.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.constraints: Allowed values: accepted, rejected, priced, booked.

responseFields.name: updatedAt
responseFields.description: Time of the latest state change.

name: Check transfer
description: Check one transfer against limits, account status and fraud rules.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Not guaranteed. Use the documented business identifier to prevent duplicates.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: reasons
responseFields.description: Failed checks. Empty when approved is true.

responseFields.name: ruleSetVersion
responseFields.description: Version of the applied check rules.

name: Get account
description: Return the status and currency of one account.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Get exchange rate
description: Return the exchange rate for one currency pair and date.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: rate
responseFields.description: Units of the second currency for one unit of the first.

responseFields.name: effectiveDate
responseFields.description: Date on which the rate applies.

name: Get fee rule
description: Return the fee for one type of transfer.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Book transfer
description: Take money out of one account and add it to another.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent by transferId. One transfer can create one active booking.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: lines
requestFields.description: Money out and money in, one line each.
requestFields.constraints: At least two lines. Total out must equal total in plus fees.

responseFields.name: totalIn
responseFields.description: Sum of money in, including the fee account.

name: Get booking
description: Return the booking lines of one transfer.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Start warehouse load
description: Start one load into the Reporting Warehouse.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: One active run for each businessDate and mode.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: queuedAt
responseFields.description: Time the run entered the queue.

name: Get load status
description: Return the state of one warehouse load.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.constraints: Allowed values: queued, running, completed, failed.

name: Get daily payments report
description: Return the payments report for one date.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: currency
requestFields.description: Limit the report to one currency.

name: Generate report
description: Start one daily payments report run.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: One report run for each reportDate and format.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: outputUri
responseFields.description: Location of the file after completion.

name: Delete notification subscription
description: Remove one notification subscription.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent. Deleting a removed subscription returns 204.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Send notification
description: Send one message to a customer or an operator.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Not guaranteed. The caller must prevent duplicate messages.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: recipient
requestFields.description: Phone number, email address or system identifier.

name: Payments DB
description: Transfers, transfer history and check results

description: Accounts, fee rules and exchange rates

description: Money taken out of and added to accounts

description: Completed transfers organised for daily reporting

name: transfer
description: Current state of each accepted transfer

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount sent, in the transfer currency.

grain: One row for the current version of each transfer.
updatePattern: Insert on acceptance. Update on change or state change.

name: transfer_event
description: Permanent record of each transfer state change
grain: One row for each transfer state change.

relationships.description: Each event belongs to one transfer.

name: check_result
description: Failed checks for each transfer

columns.name: field
columns.description: Input field that failed the check.

columns.name: message
columns.example: The receiver account does not exist.

grain: One row for each failed check.
updatePattern: Replaced when the checks run again.

relationships.cardinality: Many check results to one transfer
relationships.description: Each check result belongs to one transfer.

name: check_result_legacy
description: Check results from the retired check service

columns.name: legacy_code
columns.description: Code used by the retired check service.

grain: One row for each archived check result.
retention: Until the archive owner approves removal.

relationships.cardinality: Many archived results to one transfer
relationships.description: Logical link only. No database constraint.

name: account
description: Status and currency of each account
retention: Current row plus 10 years of history.

name: fee_rule
description: Fee for each type of transfer
grain: One row for each transfer type and start date.

name: exchange_rate
description: Daily exchange rate for each currency pair

columns.name: rate
columns.description: Units of the second currency for one unit of the first.

grain: One row for each currency pair and date.

name: booking
description: One booking for each completed transfer
updatePattern: Insert when Account Booking accepts a booking.

name: booking_line
description: Money out and money in for each booking

columns.name: amount_out
columns.description: Money taken out of the account. Zero for money in.

columns.name: amount_in
columns.description: Money added to the account. Zero for money out.

grain: One row for each money-out or money-in line.
updatePattern: Insert with its booking. Never updated.

relationships.description: Each line belongs to one booking.

name: fact_transfer
description: Completed transfers in reporting format

columns.name: transfer_key
columns.description: Warehouse key for one completed transfer.

grain: One row for each completed transfer.
updatePattern: Load during the nightly warehouse run.

relationships.description: The key identifies the reporting version of the sender account.

name: fact_daily_total
description: Total of completed transfers for each date and currency

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: Sum of completed transfers for the date and currency.

grain: One row for each report date and currency.
updatePattern: Rebuilt during the nightly warehouse run.

relationships.cardinality: Many daily totals to one currency
relationships.description: Each total belongs to one currency.

name: dim_account
description: Reporting versions of each account

columns.name: valid_from_ts
columns.description: Time from which the row is valid.

grain: One row for each reporting version of an account.
updatePattern: Insert a new row when the account changes.
retention: 10 years after the last valid date.

name: dim_currency
description: Currencies used in reports
updatePattern: Update when a currency is added.

name: load_audit
description: Result and row count of each warehouse load

columns.name: completed_at
columns.description: Completion time. Null while the load runs.

grain: One row for each warehouse load.
updatePattern: Insert at start. Update at completion or failure.
